```yaml
name: "📊 Replay Benchmark"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.lock
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Check environment
        run: |
          python check_env.py --auto-install

      - name: Run replay benchmark
        id: run_benchmark
        run: |
          python scripts/run_replay_bench.py

      - name: Upload benchmark results
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: Replay Benchmark
          tool: 'custom'
          output-file-path: replay_metrics.csv
          gh-pages-branch: main
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          auto-push: true
          comment-always: true
          summary-always: true
          save-data-file: true

      - name: Update benchmark history in docs
        run: |
          # Create or update the benchmark history CSV
          if [ ! -f docs/bench_history.csv ]; then
            echo "timestamp,metric,value" > docs/bench_history.csv
          fi
          
          # Append current benchmark results
          tail -n +2 replay_metrics.csv | while IFS=',' read -r timestamp metric value; do
            echo "${timestamp},${metric},${value}" >> docs/bench_history.csv
          done

      - name: Commit updated benchmark data
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "chore: update benchmark data"
          file_pattern: docs/bench_history.csv replay_metrics.csv

      - name: Update README with badge
        run: |
          # Get latest benchmark result
          LATEST_RESULT=$(tail -n 1 replay_metrics.csv | cut -d',' -f3)
          
          # Create badge content
          BADGE_CONTENT="![Replay Benchmark](https://img.shields.io/badge/replay_benchmark-${LATEST_RESULT}-blue)"
          
          # Update README.md with badge
          sed -i "/<!-- BENCHMARK_BADGE -->/r /dev/stdin" README.md <<< "$BADGE_CONTENT"
          sed -i '/<!-- BENCHMARK_BADGE -->/d' README.md

      - name: Commit updated README
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "docs: update benchmark badge in README"
          file_pattern: README.md
```
